"""Isolated real-SDK probe; no application change, model or cloud call."""
import importlib.metadata
import json

from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter
from galileo_core.schemas.logging.span import AgentSpan, LlmSpan, ToolSpan, RetrieverSpan
from galileo_core.schemas.shared.document import Document
from splunk_ao.otel import start_splunk_ao_span


def message(role, value):
    return json.dumps([{"role": role, "parts": [{"type": "text", "content": json.dumps(value)}]}])


exporter = InMemorySpanExporter()
provider = TracerProvider()
provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(exporter))
trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)

agent = AgentSpan(name="invoke_agent Incident Desk", input="Check checkout", output="Fixture checked")
with start_splunk_ao_span(agent) as parent:
    parent.set_attribute("gen_ai.provider.name", "ollama")
    for name, result, failed in [("health", {"status": "degraded"}, False), ("incident", None, False), ("dependency", None, True)]:
        args = {"service": "checkout"}
        record = ToolSpan(name=name, input=json.dumps(args), output=json.dumps(result) if result is not None else None)
        try:
            with start_splunk_ao_span(record) as span:
                span.update_name("execute_tool " + name)
                span.set_attribute("gen_ai.input.messages", message("user", args))
                if failed:
                    span.set_attribute("error.type", "RuntimeError")
                    raise RuntimeError("Synthetic dependency failure")
                span.set_attribute("gen_ai.output.messages", message("assistant", result))
                if result is None:
                    span.set_attribute("output.value", "null")
        except RuntimeError:
            pass
    retrieval = RetrieverSpan(name="retrieve checkout docs", input="checkout", output=[Document(content="Synthetic checkout guide")])
    with start_splunk_ao_span(retrieval) as span:
        span.set_attribute("gen_ai.input.messages", message("user", "checkout"))
        span.set_attribute("gen_ai.output.messages", message("assistant", [{"content": "Synthetic checkout guide"}]))
    model = LlmSpan(name="chat qwen3:8b", input=[{"role": "user", "content": "Check checkout"}], output={"role": "assistant", "content": "Fixture checked"}, model="qwen3:8b")
    with start_splunk_ao_span(model) as span:
        span.set_attribute("gen_ai.provider.name", "ollama")
        span.set_attribute("gen_ai.request.stream", False)

spans = exporter.get_finished_spans()
assert len(spans) == 6
parent_span = next(s for s in spans if s.name.startswith("invoke_agent"))
for span in spans:
    if span is not parent_span:
        assert span.context.trace_id == parent_span.context.trace_id
        assert span.parent.span_id == parent_span.context.span_id
    if span.name.startswith("execute_tool"):
        assert "gen_ai.input.messages" in span.attributes
        if span.name.endswith("dependency"):
            assert span.status.status_code.name == "ERROR"
            assert span.attributes["error.type"] == "RuntimeError"
            assert "gen_ai.output.messages" not in span.attributes
            assert "gen_ai.tool.call.result" not in span.attributes
        else:
            assert "gen_ai.output.messages" in span.attributes
            if span.name.endswith("incident"):
                assert span.attributes["output.value"] == "null"
                assert "gen_ai.tool.call.result" not in span.attributes
result = {
    "proof_scope": "installed SDK helper with standard in-memory OTel export; no live application, model or cloud",
    "versions": {p: importlib.metadata.version(p) for p in ["splunk-ao", "galileo-core", "opentelemetry-sdk"]},
    "pass": ["SDK-created spans", "same-span writable tool message mappings", "successful null using OpenInference output.value", "no produced result on failure", "parent/context preserved"],
    "remaining": ["start_splunk_ao_span emits INTERNAL for LlmSpan; separate-process Ollama requires CLIENT", "fresh app integration and actual OTLP wire not exercised"],
    "spans": [{"name": s.name, "trace_id": format(s.context.trace_id, "032x"), "span_id": format(s.context.span_id, "016x"), "parent_id": format(s.parent.span_id, "016x") if s.parent else None, "kind": s.kind.name, "status": s.status.status_code.name, "attributes": dict(s.attributes)} for s in spans],
}
with open("sdk-helper-probe.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(result, f, indent=2)
provider.shutdown()
print(json.dumps({"versions": result["versions"], "pass": result["pass"], "remaining": result["remaining"]}, indent=2))

GenAI instrumentations that can instrument tool execution calls SHOULD do so, unless another instrumentation can reliably cover all supported tool types. MCP tool executions may also be traced by the [corresponding MCP instrumentation](/docs/gen-ai/mcp.md#client). Tools are often executed directly by application code. Application developers are encouraged to follow this semantic convention for tools invoked by their own code and to manually instrument any tool calls that automatic instrumentations do not cover. Some tools are specialized, such as [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) that agentic frameworks expose as tools. Instrumentations SHOULD distinguish generic tools from specialized ones using framework-specific tool names or other heuristics and record the applicable [refinement](/docs/gen-ai/gen-ai-agent-spans.md#execute-tool-span). [2] | `timeout`; `java.net.UnknownHostException`; `server_certificate_invalid`; `500` | | [`gen_ai.agent.name`](/docs/registry/attributes/gen-ai.md) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Conditionally Required` When applicable. | string | The human-readable name of the agent executing the tool. | `Math Tutor`; `Fiction Writer` | | [`gen_ai.conversation.id`](/docs/registry/attributes/gen-ai.md) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Conditionally Required` If available. | string | The unique identifier for a conversation (session, thread), used to store and correlate messages within this conversation. [3] | `conv_5j66UpCpwteGg4YSxUnt7lPY` | | [`gen_ai.tool.call.id`](/docs/registry/attributes/gen-ai.md) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` If available. | string | The tool call identifier. | `call_mszuSIzqtI65i1wAUOE8w5H4` | | [`gen_ai.tool.description`](/docs/registry/attributes/gen-ai.md) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` If available. | string | The tool description. [4] | `Multiply two numbers` | | [`gen_ai.tool.type`](/docs/registry/attributes/gen-ai.md) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` If available. | string | Type of the tool utilized by the agent [5] | `function`; `extension`; `datastore` | | [`gen_ai.tool.call.arguments`](/docs/registry/attributes/gen-ai.md) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Opt-In` | any | Parameters passed to the tool call. [6] | {
    "location": "San Francisco?",
    "date": "2025-10-01"
} | | [`gen_ai.tool.call.result`](/docs/registry/attributes/gen-ai.md) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Opt-In` | any | The result returned by the tool call (if any and if execution was successful). [7] | {

  },

} |

**[3] `gen_ai.conversation.id`:** Instrumentations SHOULD populate conversation id when they have an identifier
for the conversation readily available for a given operation, for example:

- when the client framework being instrumented manages conversation history
(see [LlamaIndex chat store](https://docs.llamaindex.ai/en/stable/module_guides/storing/chat_stores/),
[LangChain `session_id`](https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain-core/runnables/history/RunnableWithMessageHistory),
and [Google ADK sessions](https://adk.dev/sessions/session))
- when instrumenting GenAI client libraries that maintain a conversation on the backend
(see [AWS Bedrock agent sessions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/agents-session-state.html),
[OpenAI Assistant threads](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/threads))

When no identifier for the conversation is available, instrumentations SHOULD NOT
populate conversation id. For example, a new UUID, a trace identifier, or a hash
of request content SHOULD NOT be used as a fallback value.

Application developers that manage conversation history MAY add conversation id to GenAI and other
spans or logs using custom span or log record processors or hooks provided by instrumentation
libraries.

**[4] `gen_ai.tool.description`:**

> [!WARNING]
> This attribute may contain sensitive information.

**[5] `gen_ai.tool.type`:** Extension: A tool executed on the agent-side to directly call external APIs, bridging the gap between the agent and real-world systems.
  Agent-side operations involve actions that are performed by the agent on the server or within the agent's controlled environment.
Function: A tool executed on the client-side, where the agent generates parameters for a predefined function, and the client executes the logic.
  Client-side operations are actions taken on the user's end or within the client application.
Datastore: A tool used by the agent to access and query structured or unstructured external data for retrieval-augmented tasks or knowledge updates.

The following attributes can be important for making sampling decisions
and SHOULD be provided **at span creation time** (if provided at all):

* [`gen_ai.agent.name`](/docs/registry/attributes/gen-ai.md)
* [`gen_ai.operation.name`](/docs/registry/attributes/gen-ai.md)
* [`gen_ai.tool.name`](/docs/registry/attributes/gen-ai.md)
* [`gen_ai.tool.type`](/docs/registry/attributes/gen-ai.md)

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass
from galileo_core.schemas.logging.span import AgentSpan, ToolSpan, LlmSpan
from splunk_ao.otel import start_splunk_ao_span

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TurnContext:
    conversation_id: str

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FixedAgentConfig:
    name: str = "Incident Desk"
    description: str = "Read synthetic health and summarize with one configured model."
    model: str = "qwen3:8b"
    provider: str = "ollama"

# One fixed agent configuration; the public turn API has no model choice.
FIXED_AGENT = FixedAgentConfig()

TOOLS = {
    "get_service_health": {
        "type": "function",
        "description": "Read synthetic health for the named service.",
    }
}

async def get_service_health(service):
    return {"service": service, "status": "degraded", "error_rate": 0.038}

async def execute_tool(context, tool_name, arguments):
    definition = TOOLS[tool_name]
    record = ToolSpan(name=tool_name, input=json.dumps(arguments))
    with start_splunk_ao_span(record) as span:
        span.set_attribute("gen_ai.tool.type", definition["type"])
        result = await get_service_health(**arguments)
        record.output = json.dumps(result)
        return result

async def agent_turn(context, question, client):
    record = AgentSpan(name=FIXED_AGENT.name, input=question)
    with start_splunk_ao_span(record) as span:
        span.set_attribute("gen_ai.provider.name", FIXED_AGENT.provider)
        result = await execute_tool(context, "get_service_health", {"service": "checkout"})
        model_record = LlmSpan(name="chat " + FIXED_AGENT.model, model=FIXED_AGENT.model,
                               input=[{"role": "user", "content": question}])
        with start_splunk_ao_span(model_record) as model_span:
            model_span.set_attribute("gen_ai.provider.name", FIXED_AGENT.provider)
            reply = await client.chat(model=FIXED_AGENT.model,
                                      messages=[{"role": "user", "content": question}])
            model_record.output = reply
        record.output = reply
        return {"result": result, "answer": reply}

# The caller supplies this non-sensitive opaque conversation binding for the
# synthetic source case; it is not a trace ID or a user/session identity.
context = TurnContext(conversation_id="conv_demo_approved_72fbd8")
# agent_turn(context, "Check checkout", a_separate_process_model_client)

from galileo_core.schemas.logging.span import AgentSpan, LlmSpan
from splunk_ao.otel import start_splunk_ao_span

ALLOWED_MODELS = ("qwen3:8b", "gpt-oss:20b")

async def dynamic_agent_turn(question, requested_model, client):
    if requested_model not in ALLOWED_MODELS:
        raise ValueError("unsupported model")
    agent_record = AgentSpan(name="Model Router", input=question)
    with start_splunk_ao_span(agent_record) as agent_span:
        agent_span.set_attribute("gen_ai.provider.name", "ollama")
        model_record = LlmSpan(name="chat " + requested_model, model=requested_model,
                               input=[{"role": "user", "content": question}])
        with start_splunk_ao_span(model_record) as model_span:
            model_span.set_attribute("gen_ai.provider.name", "ollama")
            reply = await client.chat(model=requested_model,
                                      messages=[{"role": "user", "content": question}])
            model_record.output = reply
        agent_record.output = reply
        return reply

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WorkflowContext:
    conversation_id: str

async def collect_service_health(service):
    return {"service": service, "status": "degraded"}

class SummaryAgent:
    name = "Summary Agent"
    description = "Summarize collected synthetic service health."
    model = "qwen3:8b"

    async def invoke(self, context, question, health, client):
        reply = await client.chat(
            model=self.model,
            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": question},
                      {"role": "user", "content": json.dumps(health)}],
        )
        return reply

class IncidentTriageWorkflow:
    name = "Incident triage"
    steps = ("collect_service_health", "summarize_agent", "finalize_report")

    def __init__(self):
        self.summary_agent = SummaryAgent()

    async def run(self, context, question, service, client):
        health = await collect_service_health(service)
        summary = await self.summary_agent.invoke(context, question, health, client)
        return {"service": service, "health": health, "summary": summary}
